subject: [PATCH 2/5] fuse: convert ext_map iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

reviews.author: Christoph Hellwig
reviews.summary: The conversion looks good and Christoph has added a Reviewed-by tag to indicate his approval.
reviews.raw_body:
Hmm, it would have been nice to CC adding a new creative iomap use
to the relevants lists..

Anyway, the conversion looks good:

Reviewed-by: Christoph Hellwig <hch@lst.de>

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch series converts the fuse ext_map iomap operations to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using the DEFINE_IOMAP_ITER_NEXT() macro. This change does not introduce any functional changes and only updates the iomap operation callbacks.
